scope: One tracked F02 risk-fleet item ledger, aggregate stock/backorder/waiting and resource report interpretation; same seed and physical experiment as accepted F02.var02. The only source edits enable TRACK for two item types and append half-hour ITEM ResultCollection.
expected_timeline: Risk mission critical fault around h46.4896; base LRU backorder starts around h47.9896.
Physical stocked depot LRU travels to BASE for two hours and clears backorder around h49.9896.
Failed LRU travels BASE to DEPOT and the failed SRU is exchanged and repaired; depot LRU/SRU stock eventually restores to two each.
Resource queue occurs while one shared P-CREW or P-MAINT is occupied. Aggregate resource counts must reconcile to two allocated resources.
At h60 both aircraft are ready, aggregate backorder is zero, and no resource request remains.
acceptance_hypotheses: Guarded SSH0/mutex/GUI13340 import, export, calculation and default report produce zero conversion errors and no new unreviewed warnings; populated authored tables roundtrip exactly.

A second report-only native export from the sealed result using a locally rebuilt and SHA-pinned item selector exposes a TEACH-LRU-01/DEPOT-01 ItemResults series. It must identify nominal stock separately from physical on-hand; exact time-series values are observed and independently reconciled, not assumed by the contract.

Event-derived physical stock, backorder duration, report StockTotalResults NBO/WT and ResourceResults occupied/waiting counts agree within stated bin integration tolerance. ItemResultsTotal is a horizon aggregate rather than a terminal count.
No claim is made for every item position, every resource type, or all waiting-time metrics; J08 remains open after this bounded slice.
